description: This script manages CircleCI and GitHub Actions workflows, filtering jobs and workflows, and automating git commits for configuration changes.

methods.name: add_job
methods.description: Adds a job to the workflows dictionary under the specified workflow name and type, handling dependencies.

methods.name: get_filtered_circleci_config
methods.description: Filters the CircleCI workflows to include only specified relevant jobs.

methods.name: commit_ci
methods.description: Performs a git commit with the specified files and message, after checking for unstaged changes.
